title: LLMLL Proof Artifact
description: PROOF-ARTIFACT (staged MVP) — a unified, reproducible verification record emitted by `llmll verify <file> --proof-artifact <FILE>` and re-derived by `llmll replay-artifact <FILE>`. A SYNTHESIS of the existing trust-report / obligation-report / .fq / .verified.json surfaces; it introduces no new proof obligation. Settled design: docs/design/proof-artifact-proposal.md (Rev 2). The §4.1 LCF faithfulness invariant is enforced structurally by the emitter and re-checked on deserialization (a positive-tier function record claiming refuted, or carrying a fallback_reason, or recording a discriminative axis without a basis, is ill-formed and is rejected on parse).

proof_artifact_version.description: Version of THIS artifact schema, bumped independently of the surfaces it composes.

composed_versions.description: Versions this artifact embeds rather than re-mints (proposal Risk 6).

schema_version.description: JSON-AST schemaVersion the run was produced under.

source_path.description: The source file the artifact was built from; replay recomputes its hash.

source_hash.description: "sha256:" identity / staleness driver. Replay fails closed on a mismatch.

solver.description: The pinned determinism inputs for replay (§4.3) — version ALONE is insufficient.

codegen_semantics_version.description: Distinguishes unbounded `int` from a future bounded `machine-int` (LLMLL.md §5.3.5:1051). Replay fails closed on a mismatch.

solver_result.description: `unknown` is a DISTINCT fail-closed outcome (needs-re-verify), never read as a verdict.

vc.description: The full .fq verification condition — the R-property (replay) proof trace for the SMT tier.

unsat_core.description: RESERVED (deferred): the minimized proof trace. Not surfaced in the staged MVP (Z3's core is not cheaply available through liquid-fixpoint). The full `vc` carries the R-property meanwhile.

functions.description: Per-function projections. Each is minted only through the §4.1 LCF kernel.

certificate.description: RESERVED for the Lean tier (the C-property — independent checkability) ONLY. Never a Z3 proof object (proposal §4.4, Risk 5).

functionRecord.description: A per-function record. §4.1 invariant (enforced by the emitter and re-checked on parse): if `evidence_level` is positive (verified / contract-checked / tested) then `refuted` must be false, `fallback_reason` must be null when `evidence_level` is `verified`, and a present `discriminative_axis` must carry a `basis`.

caller_obligations.description: `requires` predicates a caller must discharge to invoke this function soundly.

fallback_reason.description: Why the body left the body-faithful fragment; null iff body-faithful.

refuted.description: Orthogonal negative evidence; necessarily false on a positive tier.

basis.description: The CDP basis Ω; required when the axis is present (its observational caveat travels with it).
